defects.source_says: EO 11873 (signed 1975-07-21, 40 FR 30617) amends 'Section 2 of Executive Order No. 11868 ... to read as follows' (new membership text), so the original sec. 2 wording first ended 1975-07-21 on the claim's own replacement convention (as used for sec4-c/EO 11936); EO 11948 sec. 3 only revokes the order and does not replace sec. 2 (EO 11948 was signed 1976-12-20, not 1977-01-16). The claim lists no EO 11873 event for sec2 and misattributes the replacement.

reasoning: All 37 quoted spans and hashes match held texts. But the sec2 clause first end is wrong/inconsistent with EO 11873 text, and the rationale misstates that EO 11948 replaces sec. 2 and dates EO 11948 as 1977-01-16. Rejected for wrong actor/mechanism/date on sec2 and internal inconsistency.
